data.long_meaning: Jayanti is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Jayanti', meaning 'victory' or 'triumph'. This name is associated with the goddess Durga, who symbolizes the power of victory over evil. It is also a name given to children born during Diwali, the Hindu festival of lights. The name Jayanti carries the meaning “Victory, Triumph” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Jayanti usually hope their child will grow to embody victory, triumph and live with faith, good character and purpose.
